label: Government
description: Executive branch, head of state, cabinet ministers, government agencies

label: Military
description: Armed forces, defense ministry, national guard

label: Police / Law Enforcement
description: Police, border patrol, immigration enforcement agencies (e.g. ICE, CBP)

label: Intelligence Services
description: Intelligence agencies, spy services, national security apparatus

label: NGO / Civil Society
description: Non-governmental organizations, civil society groups, advocacy organizations

label: Human Rights Organization
description: Human rights groups, watchdogs (e.g. Amnesty International, Human Rights Watch)

label: Religious Institution
description: Churches, mosques, temples, religious groups and their leadership

label: Media / Journalist
description: News organizations, journalists, reporters, media outlets

label: Academic / Research
description: Universities, researchers, think tanks, academic institutions

label: Intergovernmental Organization
description: UN agencies (UNHCR, IOM, UNICEF), OAS, EU, regional bodies

label: Refugee / Migrant
description: Refugees, asylum seekers, migrants, displaced persons

label: Political Opposition
description: Opposition parties, dissidents, political opponents of the government

label: Rebel / Armed Opposition
description: Rebel groups, armed opposition, non-state armed actors

label: Business / Corporate
description: Companies, corporations, business associations, private sector
